about: A self-hosted status page that checks websites and services and sends alerts when they go down.

prs.title: Checks on large numbers in a response compare correctly
prs.broken: A check that a number in the response equals 1234567 always failed, because numbers of a million or more were turned into scientific notation and no longer matched.
prs.changed: Numbers from the response are now written out in full, and decimals stay as they were.
prs.matters: Status pages stop reporting healthy services as down when they check big counts or IDs.
